title: Every year he loses his rack… and grows a bigger one 🦌
caption:
Loses it every winter. Comes back bigger every summer 🦌💪
Nature's glow-up 👇
first_comment: Did you know antlers fall off every year? 🦌👇
sources: Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'antler' (shed and regrown every year; covered in velvet while growing)

Price J. et al. (2005) 'Deer antlers: a zoological curiosity or the key to understanding organ regeneration in mammals?', Journal of Anatomy 207(5): 603-618 (growth up to about 2 cm a day, among the fastest-growing mammalian tissues)
